evidence.why: Strongest: Discord gives a numbered account from the row and OSL compares it with the signed-in account's own number, read separately from the account panel.
Strong: a stable provider account id on the row is checked against a separately observed signed-in account id, so a label alone cannot decide ownership.
Weak: an authenticated provider response may narrow candidates, but without an independent signed-in account reading it is one channel describing both sides.
Weak: it proves a registered OSL identity answered a challenge for a claimed account, not that the provider row was written by the signed-in account.
Weakest: a name on its own is weak and may only ever narrow an answer, never make one.
